scope: SQL004-to005 receipt-integrity development upgrade, actual checksum migrator and isolated PostgreSQL
checks: Owner-run forced-RLS backfill visits both tenants and distinguishes complete receipts from missing historical revisions
Actual checksum migrator replays without reapplying any of the five migrations
Malformed historical plan identity rejects005 and rolls back all schema work while preserving original receipts
Migration owner and runtime roles are non-superusers without BYPASSRLS
Owner-installed nested trigger runs as gc_app: forged parent membership is rejected by the guard and exact duplicate membership by the primary key, without granting runtime TEMP

isolation.network: none; migrator shares only the disposable database network namespace

limitations: Fixtures deliberately construct pre005 records, including an incomplete initial revision; they are not product user journeys.
This qualifies a development schema transition, not a released-version upgrade, backup restore, interrupted durable bulk migration, or complete SYS-OPS-003.
Runtime insert/update/tenant-denial and application getter behavior are qualified separately by real integration tests.
